summary: Group C (Dark theme + Ops hub + Multi-company color coding) tested end-to-end. Backend: 8/8 pytest in test_group_c_theme_ops_color.py PASS — PUT /api/profile persists company_color+company_name and returns updated user, empty string clears back to auto palette, GET /api/jobs returns company_color+company_name on every job, custom color overrides palette for that owner's jobs, cleared color reverts to a stable palette color (COMPANY_PALETTE[sum(ord(c)) % 8] per poster_id) — deterministic and stable, job creation regression works with color enrichment (POST /api/jobs -> immediate GET both show company_color), no mongo _id leaks. Frontend: owner dashboard shows single 'Ops Management Tools' card (testID ops-hub-card) and ALL legacy owner cards absent (booking-form-card, checklist-templates-card, clients-card, sms-settings-card, teams-card, operations-card, live-map-card, reconcile-card confirmed missing). /ops-hub renders all 12 grouped tool rows (hub-operations, hub-live-map, hub-reconcile, hub-booking-form, hub-checklist-templates, hub-sms-settings, hub-onboarding, hub-teams, hub-clients, hub-payroll, hub-appearance, hub-subscription); each row navigates without red-screen crashes. /appearance shows 10 swatches; picking swatch-#2B7043 + tapping save-appearance calls PUT /api/profile with company_color and after return-to-dashboard the first job card's borderLeftColor becomes rgb(43,112,67) (=#2B7043) with borderLeftWidth 4px (enrich_job feeding through). Dark theme: colors.surface=#0E1420 applied via _layout.tsx Stack contentStyle + root View; light onSurface=#EAECEF text; dashboard, ops-hub, appearance, work-hub, jobs list, profile, all sub-screens (operations, live-map, reconcile, booking-form, checklist-templates, sms-settings, clients, teams, subscription) all render in dark palette in screenshots — no white flashes, no dark-on-dark text, teal/gold/green accents preserved. Cleaner dashboard regression (cleaner@abodeops.com): driver-card, onboarding-card, clients-card, payroll-card, availability-card all present; ops-hub-card absent — spec matches. Owner company_color/company_name restored to empty on teardown so state is reset for next iteration.

issues: 'FREE Plan' banner card (top of Profile) uses sage background with a low-contrast dark subtitle — subtitle 'Ad-supported · tap to go ad-free' is barely legible on the sage tile in dark theme. Consider using colors.onSage (#0A192F) with higher weight, or swap to surfaceSecondary + colors.onSurface for the sage-branded promo banner.

action_items: Optional polish: bump the 'FREE Plan' promo card subtitle contrast on the Profile screen (subtitle text on sage background reads faintly in dark theme).
